advisories.reason: Official aws-cdk-lib@2.272.0 publishes brace-expansion@5.0.9 inside its tarball. npm audit fix reports that bundled copy cannot be replaced. The package is a devDependency of @sceneready/infrastructure-cdk only, and the MCP runtime image does not contain it.
advisories.reviewRule: Every security-audit run must match this exact package, installed version, dependency path, upstream package, upstream version, and advisory set. Any other High or any Critical fails closed.
advisories.expiryRule: Fail closed with UPSTREAM_PATCH_AVAILABLE when the newest official aws-cdk-lib release no longer bundles brace-expansion in the affected range 4.0.0 through 5.0.11. Do not auto-upgrade in CI.
